_comment: Three-take route proofs. Read by tests/test_routes.gd, which walks each route at 60 Hz against the real NPC clocks and against the ghosts recorded from the earlier takes. Every step is 'auto': the simulator finds the first instant at which that whole crossing is clear, so the waits printed by the test are results, not inputs. Edit waypoints only.
_geometry_warning: The room is 24x18 with 0.4 m walls; the player is 0.32 m wide, so every wall and prop is effectively 0.32 m bigger and a door is only as wide as the gap minus 0.64 m. Legs are straight lines: route around furniture, never through its shadow. tools/check_plan.gd reports every blocked leg in all three takes without any NPC timing.

takes._note: Learning loop, no ghosts. The receipt right next to the mark teaches the pickup; then the long west wall north into the office corner for the script page; around the script table's south side and along the top wall into the east yard, up the clear lane between the light stand and the dolly to the walkie; back through the office's east door to the clapboard on the director's desk; out the north door and home. The auto steps are the ones that cross the stagehand's lane along y=2.4.

Take 01's ghost walks the west loop first, so this route goes the other way: east along the back wall, into the office from the north door, clapboard first, out through the east door, then the yard, the top wall, and the receipt is the last pickup. Every east-yard crossing is an auto step because the stagehand owns that lane.

Two ghosts: take 01 goes west-first, take 02 goes east-first. This route holds on the mark for five seconds so take 01's ghost clears the west wall, then follows it north, takes the office from the south door, works north past the desk's west side to the clapboard, leaves by the east door, and comes home down the west wall. The proof that two recorded bodies still leave a line through the room.
